subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: This 5-day tour flies Air China from Manila to Chengdu and back from Chengdu. You drive to Chongqing for Ciqikou Ancient Town, Liziba light rail station and the old streets, then return to Chengdu and Dujiangyan for Chunxi Road, Panda Park and Guanxian Ancient City. Hotels are 4-star and the programme includes four shop stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 6–10 2026 to Feb 26–Mar 2 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A restored riverside old town in Chongqing with stone alleys, teahouses and snack shops.
placeDesc.TESTBED2: A creative and cultural complex in Chongqing visited on Day 1.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing metro station where the light rail passes through a residential building.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the entrance feels like the 1st floor but is actually on the 22nd.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping district of Chongqing around the Jiefangbei monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A Chongqing street of local snacks and Sichuan-style food to enjoy on your own.
placeDesc.Chongqing Kaibu Ruins Park: A city park in Chongqing, visited on the Day 2 city walk.
placeDesc.Danzishi Old Street: A historic street in Chongqing with old-style buildings and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Chunxi Road: Chengdu's main downtown pedestrian shopping street.
placeDesc.IFS Plaza: A modern shopping complex in Chengdu, known for the giant panda sculpture climbing its facade.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping and dining quarter in central Chengdu, built around old temples.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge: A bookstore chain known for its striking, mirrored interior design.
placeDesc.Panda Park: A giant panda park in the Chengdu area, visited with a battery bus on Day 4.
placeDesc.Guanxian Ancient City: The old town of Dujiangyan with traditional streets and shops.
placeDesc.South Bridge (Blue Tears): A scenic bridge in Dujiangyan Ancient City, popular for riverside photos.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square Panda Statue: A giant selfie-taking panda statue in Yangtianwo Square, Chengdu.
